listing.shortDescription: A small, fast code editor for Windows. Open files and folders instantly, edit with syntax highlighting, split panes, a built-in terminal, and 36 interface languages — no account, telemetry, or plugin marketplace.
listing.whatsNew: Initial Microsoft Store release: Codilo 0.4.7 brings the full editor, Explorer, terminal, split panes, session restore, and 36 interface languages to Windows.
listing.description: A small, fast code editor for Windows. Open files and folders instantly, edit with syntax highlighting, split panes, a built-in terminal, and 36 interface languages — no account, telemetry, or plugin marketplace.
features: Opens instantly: one native window, no splash screen, no background indexer.
Syntax highlighting and editing for 35 languages, with automatic detection and per-file language overrides.
Explorer with Open Folder, create, rename, delete to the Recycle Bin, and drag to move or copy.
Split panes: drag a tab to any edge to edit two or more files side by side.
Built-in terminal with PowerShell and Command Prompt sessions, opened in the current file's folder.
Find and replace, Go to Symbol, a Problems panel, and optional spell check.
Session restore reopens saved files in the same panes and at the same caret positions.
Light, dark, and low-sensory themes, adjustable zoom, and show/hide toolbar and status bar.
No account, telemetry, or plugin marketplace. A small editor that stays out of the way.
Optimized for people with sensory integration disorder - autism theme, bionic reading.
Web and documents: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, JSX, TSX, Markdown, JSON, YAML, XML.
Systems: Neper, C/C++, Rust, Go, GNU assembly, Intel/NASM assembly.
Java/.NET/mobile: Java, C#, Kotlin, Swift, Dart, Object Pascal.
Scripting: Python, R, PowerShell, Shell (sh/bash/zsh/ksh), Batch.
Config and data: TOML, Protocol Buffers, Terraform/HCL, SQL (standard, SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL).
